description: This is a Flutter widget implementation for the checkout screen in a ticket booking application. It manages user interactions during the checkout process, including displaying the order summary, accepting Terms and Privacy Policy acceptance, and handling the payment process via a provider pattern.

classes.name: CheckoutScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget representing the checkout screen where users can review their order and proceed with payment.

classes.name: _CheckoutScreenState
classes.description: The state management class for CheckoutScreen, handling widget state including user agreement and payment process.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the checkout screen, displaying order summary and handling user interactions.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the CheckoutScreen widget.
